verdict.rationale: Retell documents voice cloning from uploaded audio files (up to 25 files) and adding a custom voice clone in the agent's voice selector, so the core capability is real. However, there is no evidence of any documented consent process (e.g., consent forms, verification that the speaker authorized the clone) accompanying the cloning workflow. missing for 10: documented consent/verification process for voice cloning, any policy on rights/authorization to clone a voice, independent confirmation of clone quality for brand use.
